name: AI Chatbot (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude), WhatsApp Button, Sticky Navbar & Popups – Dear Sticky
author: Sanchit Pandey

sections.description:
Dear Sticky is a premium, high-performance conversion toolkit. In version 2.0.0, it combines AI chat support, sticky navigation, floating contact actions, WhatsApp Button and popup targeting into one dashboard.

Why settle for one AI? Dear Sticky now supports ChatGPT (OpenAI), Claude (Anthropic), and Gemini (Google), giving you the freedom to choose the best brain for your website’s automated support.

🤖 NEW: Multi-Model AI Chatbot

Turn your website into a 24/7 sales and support machine.
* Choose Your Provider: Seamlessly switch between ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini.
* Secure API Proxy: Requests are proxied through your WordPress backend so keys are not exposed in the browser.
* Trigger Controls: Auto-open on scroll depth or exit intent, or keep manual open only.
* History Persistence: Optional local storage keeps conversations between visits.

🔝 Smart Sticky Navbar & Menu

Keep your navigation accessible at all times to improve UX and reduce bounce rates.
* Universal Compatibility: Works with any theme or page builder.
* Scroll-Aware Activation: Navbar becomes sticky after users scroll past its original position.
* Style Controls: Configure drop shadow, bottom border, entry animation, and optional scroll progress indicator.
* Page Rules: Apply sticky behavior to all pages, only selected pages, or exclude selected pages.

💬 11+ Floating Action Buttons (FAB)

High-visibility shortcuts to your most important communication channels:
* WhatsApp Button: “Click to Chat” functionality with custom pre-filled messages.
* Social Shortcuts: Messenger, Telegram, Instagram, Facebook, and X (Twitter).
* Quick Actions: Click-to-call, Email, and smooth “Scroll to Top.”
* Orbital Hub Mode: Enable up to 3 active buttons with reorder support and trigger-based display.

📢 Smart Popups

  • Exit-Intent Triggers: Show a discount or lead magnet exactly when a user tries to leave.
  • Display Rules: Configure immediate, scroll-based, or timed behavior with cookie-based frequency control.
  • Targeting Controls: Device targeting, scheduling windows, and page include/exclude rules.

📈 Built-in Analytics

  • Event Tracking: Track opens, views, clicks, replies, and conversions across modules.
  • Module Views: Analyze AI chatbot, notice popup, and floating button performance separately.
  • Date Ranges: Review trends for 7, 30, 90 days, or all-time.

🚀 Performance & Design

  • Lightweight: Built to protect your Core Web Vitals (LCP/INP) with minimal CSS/JS.
  • Apple-Sleek Dashboard: A modern React-powered admin UI with a real-time mobile preview.
  • Privacy-Friendly: Settings and analytics stay inside your WordPress environment.
sections.installation:
1. Search for “Dear Sticky” in your WordPress Plugins > Add New area.
  2. Install and Activate the plugin.
  3. Navigate to the Dear Sticky menu in your sidebar.
  4. AI Setup: Go to the Chatbot tab and enter your API key for ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini.
sections.faq:
Can I use my own API keys?

Yes! You can use your own API keys for OpenAI (ChatGPT), Anthropic (Claude), or Google (Gemini) for full control over costs and limits.

Does the Sticky Navbar work with Elementor?

Absolutely. It is fully compatible with Elementor, Divi, and the Block Editor (Gutenberg).

Is the WhatsApp button a live chat?

No, the WhatsApp button is a shortcut that redirects users to the WhatsApp app/web interface on their device to message you directly.
